desc: Looking to reduce as much weight and length as possible with your build? The Kurz Q.D, Adapter from YHM allows the user to shorten their Phantom Q.D. mounting system by .675” on any suppressor utilizing the 1-3/8”-24 rear mounting threads. Don't just reduce size and weight from your build, do it with style and the durability you've come to know and love from YHM products.
